task.title: Card detail pages need a Back button
task.description: After navigating to a card detail page, there's no obvious way to go "Back". On the web app at least you can click a browsers "Back" button, but a user-facing link should be available too. And on the desktop, no such browser button exists so a link is needed. However, on the desktop a typical user browser-back navigation keyboard shortcut should work. On a Mac, this is Command-[.
